summary: Silicon Laboratories Inc. filed an 8-K reporting expiration of the HSR Act waiting period for its pending merger with Texas Instruments Incorporated. Under the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated February 4, 2026, a wholly owned subsidiary of Texas Instruments will merge into Silicon Labs, with Silicon Labs surviving as a wholly owned direct subsidiary of Texas Instruments. The filing does not disclose price per share, premium, or break fee. The HSR waiting period expired on May 22, 2026, satisfying one condition to closing. The merger remains subject to other customary regulatory approvals. What to watch: receipt of remaining regulatory clearances and shareholder vote timeline.
